message.content: {"caption":"Twelve small-multiple line charts compare accuracy across math, coding, and aggregate benchmarks; a red star marks a point on the overall-average curve.","description":"A grid of 12 single-line charts. The blue Math Reasoning section contains AIME 2024, AIME 2025, Olympiad Bench, Minerva, Math 500, and AMC 2023. The orange Code Reasoning section contains HumanEval+, MBPP+, and LiveCodeBench. The green Overall Performance section contains Math Average, Code Average, and Overall Average. The horizontal axes show numeric values from 50 to 400 in increments of 50; no horizontal-axis title is visible. Accuracy is the vertical measure, labeled on the leftmost chart in each row. Each chart has its own vertical scale, so the plotted levels should be compared with that chart’s scale. The plotted values at the horizontal-axis ticks are estimated and listed in chart_values. AIME 2024 varies sharply, reaching a low around 250 and a high around 300, then ending above its low. AIME 2025 is also erratic, with deep troughs near 200 and 350 and a peak near 300. Olympiad Bench stays within a comparatively narrow band, with a high around 180 and lower values near 350. Minerva rises early, fluctuates through the middle, drops sharply around 360, and rebounds to a high at the end. Math 500 remains relatively steady at a higher level on its scale, with small fluctuations. AMC 2023 fluctuates considerably, peaks around 290, drops late, and recovers at the final point. HumanEval+ rises to a mid-chart high and then mostly fluctuates around a fairly stable level. MBPP+ fluctuates modestly, has a trough around 260, and rises toward the end. LiveCodeBench trends upward overall, with later fluctuations. Math Average fluctuates, peaks near 300, falls sharply around 365, and rebounds. Code Average generally rises before settling into a narrow range. Overall Average fluctuates, with a red star marking the curve near horizontal value 300 and vertical value about 0.533; it then falls sharply around 350–365 and recovers by the end.
